sources.title: BamiBERT: A New BERT-based Language Model for Vietnamese
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce BamiBERT, a new BERT-based pre-trained language model for Vietnamese that addresses key limitations of PhoBERT -- the current de facto Vietnamese text encoder. sources.title: FinBERT: Financial Sentiment Analysis with BERT - GitHub
sources.snippet: FinBERT is a pre-trained NLP model to analyze sentiment of financial text. It is built by further training the BERT language model in the finance domain, using a large financial corpus and thereby fine-tuning it for financial sentiment classification.
